# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Not applicable in this repository (inbound HTTP API)

No routes, controllers, OpenAPI/GraphQL schema, or server-side handlers exist in this repo — it is a client-side widget bundled by Vite into an IIFE (`vite.config.js`) and hosted as static assets on Cloudflare Pages/Workers (`wrangler.jsonc`, `assets.not_found_handling: "single-page-application"`). The only outbound HTTP call is a `fetch` `POST` to a merchant-supplied `webhookUrl` at runtime — the widget does not own or expose that endpoint.

### Outbound webhook contract (widget → merchant-configured URL)

- Client: `src/integrations/webhook.js:postLead(webhookUrl, payload, { fetchImpl, timeoutMs })`.
- Method: `POST`; `Content-Type: text/plain` (deliberate — comment in code: "evita o preflight OPTIONS em muitos casos"); body: `JSON.stringify(payload)`.
- Auth: none implemented — no header/token added by the client; any auth is the merchant webhook's responsibility.
- Timeout: `AbortController`, default 3000ms (`config.webhookTimeoutMs`), configurable per `init()` call.
- Trigger: fired from `LeadWidget.submit()` after client-side validation passes (`src/ui/widget.js:submit`); never fired in `disableForm: true` mode (that path skips the form and webhook entirely, `src/ui/widget.js:open`).

Request body — global-subject lead (`tests/unit/payload.test.js`):

```json
{
  "nome": "Joao Silva",
  "whatsapp": "5511999999999",
  "origem_trafego": "Google / cpc",
  "url_origem": "https://loja.test",
  "data_hora": "2026-04-20 14:05:06",
  "assunto": "Pedidos"
}
```

Request body — product-context lead (`tests/unit/payload.test.js`):

```json
{
  "nome": "Maria Souza",
  "whatsapp": "5511988887777",
  "origem_trafego": "Site da loja",
  "url_origem": "https://loja.test/produto",
  "data_hora": "2026-04-20 14:05:06",
  "produto_interesse": "Anel de Diamante Vereda",
  "produto_id": "123"
}
```

Response handling (`src/integrations/webhook.js:postLead`):

| Outcome | `status` value | `reason` | Widget behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhookUrl` empty or `fetchImpl` not a function | `falha_tratada` | `missing_webhook` | Redirect to WhatsApp proceeds regardless |
| HTTP response `ok` | `sucesso` | — | Redirect proceeds, status text `'Abrindo WhatsApp...'` |
| HTTP response not `ok` | `falha_tratada` | `http_error` | Redirect proceeds, status text `'Abrindo WhatsApp mesmo assim...'` |
| Fetch aborts (timeout) | `falha_tratada` | `timeout` | Redirect proceeds |
| Fetch throws (network) | `falha_tratada` | `network_error` | Redirect proceeds |
| Honeypot filled (bot) | `abortado_honeypot` | — | Redirect does NOT proceed — submission aborted in `LeadWidget.submit` before `postLead` is called |

- No retry and no dead-letter handling implemented — a failed webhook call is logged into the returned `registration` object only; the widget does not re-attempt delivery (`src/integrations/webhook.js`, `src/ui/widget.js:submit`).
